verdicts.reason: A reverses the reading order: GADGETS sits above 'Smart Home'. Both lines are white text over the busy wood photo instead of the purple field. The signature purple circle has shrunk to a meaningless sliver in the bottom-left corner, and the outline frame floats cut off mid-image, so the brand structure is lost. B keeps the correct order and puts GADGETS on the purple shape, but GADGETS runs nearly edge to edge with almost no margin. 'Smart Home' is thin white text on light wood with weak contrast, and the frame line still ends arbitrarily, though B is closer to the original.
